title: ACE inhibitor monitoring — clean closed loop
source_note: Ramipril 2.5 mg once daily started today for hypertension. Repeat U&Es/creatinine/potassium in 10 days. Hypertension clinic to review the result.
action: Repeat renal function/electrolytes and verify documented clinician review
events: Day 0: OBLIGATION_CONFIRMED — Human confirms extracted follow-up plan. | Day 9: TEST_PERFORMED — U&Es sample collected. | Day 9: RESULT_AVAILABLE — Result enters EPR. | Day 10: REVIEW_NOTE — Clinician documents: 'Bloods reviewed; continue current plan.'
expected_system_behaviour: Close only after both action evidence and review evidence are present.
engine_test_focus: Proves the engine can close a genuine loop without generating unnecessary alerts.

title: ACE inhibitor monitoring — test never performed
source_note: Ramipril increased today. Repeat U&Es in 14 days; cardiology clinic to review.
action: Repeat U&Es following ACE inhibitor dose change
events: Day 0: OBLIGATION_CONFIRMED — Follow-up confirmed. | Day 14: NO_EVENT — No pathology result or completion evidence. | Day 15: CLOCK_ADVANCE — Due window has passed.
expected_system_behaviour: Surface the obligation as overdue; do not infer completion from the original order.
engine_test_focus: Basic 'ordered does not mean completed' failure.

title: Methotrexate monitoring — bloods returned but no review documented
source_note: Methotrexate started. FBC, LFTs and renal function in 2 weeks. Rheumatology team to review results.
action: Complete scheduled methotrexate monitoring and verify review
events: Day 13: TEST_PERFORMED — FBC/LFT/renal profile collected. | Day 13: RESULT_AVAILABLE — All requested results available in EPR. | Day 15: NO_REVIEW_EVIDENCE — No acknowledgement, note or documented action found.
expected_review_item: {"status": "OVERDUE", "owner": "Rheumatology team", "reason": "Result exists but review evidence has not appeared within benchmark review window."}
expected_system_behaviour: Do not mark complete merely because the blood test happened and results returned.
engine_test_focus: Directly tests the distinction between action completion and clinical review.

title: Methotrexate monitoring — review documented messily in free text
source_note: Repeat FBC/LFT/U&Es in 2 weeks after methotrexate initiation. Rheumatology to review.
events: Day 14: RESULT_AVAILABLE — Requested results available. | Day 15: FREE_TEXT_NOTE — Telephone note states: 'Bloods okay from yesterday, happy to continue as planned.' No structured result acknowledgement.
expected_review_item: {"status": "OPEN", "owner": "Rheumatology team", "reason": "Likely review evidence found in free text; human confirmation required."}
expected_system_behaviour: Create a human confirmation item rather than a hard missed-review alert.
engine_test_focus: Tests whether the system avoids destroying trust through false positives.

title: Explicit follow-up with no accountable owner
source_note: Repeat renal profile in 7 days. Please ensure results are reviewed.
action: Repeat renal profile and verify review
events: Day 0: OBLIGATION_CONFIRMED — Human confirms the follow-up exists but cannot identify an accountable clinician/team. | Day 1: CLOCK_ADVANCE — Obligation remains within due window.
expected_system_behaviour: Surface immediately as an ownership risk without inventing an owner from note authorship.
engine_test_focus: Tests the no-owner primitive independently of timeliness.

title: MRI cancelled — underlying investigation obligation remains open
benchmark_role: true positive / cancellation does not equal completion
source_note: MRI brain to be completed within 21 days; neurology secretary/radiology booking team to ensure completion.
events: Day 8: APPOINTMENT_BOOKED — MRI booked for day 15. | Day 15: APPOINTMENT_CANCELLED — Scan could not proceed; booking episode is closed. | Day 16: NO_REBOOKING — No replacement appointment recorded. | Day 22: CLOCK_ADVANCE — Original completion window passed.
expected_system_behaviour: A cancelled appointment must not close the underlying clinical obligation.
engine_test_focus: Models the documented HSSIB failure mode where cancellation made outstanding follow-up hard to see.

title: Unexpected radiology finding — report read but follow-up not completed
benchmark_role: true positive / read receipt is not completion
source_note: Chest X-ray report: unexpected focal opacity; recommend CT chest within 14 days. ED results team to ensure follow-up.
events: Day 2: REPORT_OPENED — Radiology report opened in results inbox; read receipt generated. | Day 2: NO_ACTION — No CT request or documented management action. | Day 15: CLOCK_ADVANCE — No CT completion evidence by deadline.
expected_system_behaviour: Ignore report-open/read receipt as proof that the recommended downstream action was completed.
engine_test_focus: Tests HSSIB's finding that acknowledgement/read receipt is not assurance of action.

title: Planned outpatient review never booked after discharge
source_note: Discharge plan: cardiology follow-up in 4 weeks. Cardiology booking team to arrange.
action: Cardiology outpatient appointment takes place within planned window
events: Day 1: DISCHARGED — Discharge summary contains explicit follow-up plan. | Day 14: NO_APPOINTMENT — No outpatient appointment exists in booking feed. | Day 29: CLOCK_ADVANCE — Four-week window has passed with no booked/completed appointment.
expected_system_behaviour: Detect that an explicit outpatient follow-up plan never became a completed appointment.
engine_test_focus: Directly reflects the HSSIB safety risk of intended-but-not-booked appointments.

title: Medication plan changes — old monitoring obligation is superseded
source_note: Spironolactone started. U&Es/renal function in 1 week. Heart failure team to review.
events: Day 0: OBLIGATION_CONFIRMED — Monitoring obligation confirmed. | Day 3: PLAN_CHANGED — Clinician documents that spironolactone has been stopped and creates a new medication-monitoring plan. | Day 3: SUPERSESSION_LINK — Original obligation linked to replacement obligation CCE-009-R1. | Day 8: CLOCK_ADVANCE — Original due date passes.
expected_system_behaviour: Do not generate an overdue alert for an obligation legitimately replaced by a documented new plan.
engine_test_focus: Prevents legitimate clinical changes being misclassified as failures or cancellations.

title: Manual closure attempt without evidence
source_note: Repeat FBC in 7 days and review result in clinic inbox.
events: Day 8: CLOCK_ADVANCE — No FBC result found; obligation is overdue. | Day 8: MANUAL_COMPLETE_ATTEMPT — User attempts to mark obligation COMPLETE with no supporting evidence.
expected_system_behaviour: Reject or gate the completion attempt unless a structured override reason, actor, timestamp and rationale/evidence are supplied; preserve previous machine-derived state in the audit log.
engine_test_focus: Tests the defensive audit model and prevents dashboard gaming.
